correctness.rationale: Poisson-thinning and offspring typing yield exact matrix M. Its Perron root follows by quadratic formula. For c != d, f second derivative h²q²/[h²(1-t)²+q²t²]^(3/2)>0, and endpoint derivatives -max(c,d), q-s give the iff strict interior criterion. Closed optimizer derives by tangency, checked algebraically and by finite program. Rational example det(I-M)=(-363 t²+308 t-29)/400; algebraic roots (14±sqrt109)/33 and symmetric positive-definite criterion certify the entire subcritical interval. At endpoints accessibility of the supercritical strain holds. Standalone verify.py passed 21,615 exact and sampled arithmetic assertions; finite checks are corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The verified contribution is not discovery of mutation-multilayer branching thresholds, generic strict convexity of spectral interpolations, or nonmonotone contact thresholds. It is a specialized sharp if-and-only-if interior layer-allocation condition q>(c+d)/2 for a fixed-contact-budget Poisson two-strain epidemic with identity versus swap mutation, including the exact optimizer and exact two-supercritical-layer/one-subcritical-mixture interval. Sood et al. give the multilayer branching framework; Min et al. demonstrate qualitatively nonmonotone spread from path-dependent layer switching. Inspected mathematical statements do not establish this precise identity/swap contact-budget phase classification. Accessible published published-finding corpus research records closest in spectral epidemic thresholds and mutation did not imply the specialized phase classification after statement/implication comparisons. Priority may still be affected by uninspected supplementary matter or a broad spectral interpolation result.
residual_risks: A broad affine nonnegative two-by-two Perron optimization theorem might subsume the algebraic phase classification; not independently ruled out by a complete literature census.
Sood et al. supplementary appendix and some broad primary mathematical papers were not fully examined; novelty of precise mutation-specialized statement retains priority risk.
Existing nonmonotone thresholds and epidemic Parrondo effects are prior art, so no novelty claim is made for those generic ideas.
No independent scientific review has been conducted.

value.rationale: Fixed total contact budget and two opposing mutation mechanisms are epidemiologically interpretable natural constraints. The theorem provides a sharp comparison between mutation geometric mean and preserving-layer arithmetic mean and an exact design/allocation criterion. The rational example proves a genuine epidemiological qualitative transition: each pure layer supercritical from an accessible initial strain, but many mixtures subcritical. This is not a routine relabeling, a mere numeric counterexample, or a generic assertion of known multiplex nonmonotonicity. The precise iff phase frontier and its extinction window are the motivated structural content.
